company_notes:
- Primary product: mobile personalization SDK (server-side ranking + short chat assistant).
- Core ask: latency- and cost-sensitive realtime inference. SLOs: p95 < 120ms for conversational token responses, p50 ~40-60ms.
- Traffic shape: mostly short-turnchat and reranking calls. Typical prompt + context ~8-14 tokens generated. Spiky throughput (campaign bursts to ~1.2k rps).
- Customer is sensitive to cost-per-token; wants to compare Dedicated commit vs hosted with smart routing.
- Optimization interests: batching tradeoffs (want micro-batching that doesn't add >20ms tail), prefix/KV caching between sessions, and aggressive quantization (int8 -> int4) with automated quality gates.
- Quality constraints: offline eval set of 1k prompts must show <2% degradation on top-1 rerank accuracy when using quantized models.
- CTO comment: "We need predictable latency — can't have batch windows that add jitter to tail latency." Emphasis on graceful degradation: fallback model variants in other regions.
- Technical constraints: VPC peering to us-west, strict logging retention controls, must integrate with customer KMS for key wrapping.
- POC success criteria: p95 latency under target at 1k rps sustained for 30m, end-to-end cost projection for 3 deployment options (hosted, dedicated, private), pass security questionnaire items 1-12.
perf_requirements_summary: p95 < 120ms for chat generation (8-14 tokens), throughput target 1k rps for peak, cost target < $8 per 1M generated tokens; measure latency and cost across A100/H100/L4 and quantization levels (fp16/int8/int4)
evaluation_notes: Customer expects Redwood Optimize to provide: batching/caching/cost tradeoff matrix, recommended kernel/quantization profile, and an automated benchmark harness they can re-run. Wants Jupyter-style report + raw logs.
